Hero.description: Stake, play, and grow your network across roulette, slots, sports, and affiliate rewards — all in one unified galaxy ecosystem.

features.title: Connect Your Wallet
features.desc: Link your wallet to access staking, games, and affiliate rewards across the SoftGalaxy ecosystem.

features.title: Stake & Play
features.desc: Stake BET tokens for passive income or dive into roulette, slots, and sports betting.

features.title: Grow Your Network
features.desc: Build your binary or linear genealogy tree and earn commissions from your affiliate structure.

HIW.title: Setup Your wallet
HIW.paregraf: Set up your wallet of choice. Connect it to by clicking the wallet icon in the top right.

HIW.title: Create Collection
HIW.paregraf: Upload your work and setup your collection Add a description, social links and floor price.

HIW.title: Start Earning
HIW.paregraf: Choose between auctions and fixed-price listings. Start earning by selling your NFTs or trading.

A cosmic journey through uncharted nebulae, painted in the raw colors of interstellar dust and stellar winds.
An otherworldly creature born from the neon-soaked jungles of a synthetic future. Unique 1/1.
Growing in the void between dimensions, this mystical fungus carries secrets of ancient digital realms.
Fluid motion captured in chrome and circuitry. A dancer built for the dancefloor of eternity.
Under the electric sky, a lone figure walks the aurora plains. Silence speaks louder than stars.
Every pixel in this artwork encodes a star cluster. The universe fits in 4096 pixels.
A ape phased across three holographic planes. Proof that primates mastered the metaverse first.
Each petal encodes a hidden message. Decode the blossom, unlock the secret of the digital spring.
When the simulation reaches its daily limit, this is the last frame rendered before shutdown.
Bred from stardust and neural nets, the galaxy foxhound roams freely across the open source wilds.
The engine that powers the interplanetary rave. RPM: infinite. Fuel: pure rhythm.
A chain of digital islands, each one a block in the ledger of an underwater blockchain civilization.
The mycelium internet predates blockchain by 400 million years. This NFT proves it.
At the edge of Edena, where the simulation meets the void, only art survives.
Faster than light, this hound navigates warp lanes across six galaxies in search of rare tokens.
Every bear has a constellation. This one wears the entire Milky Way.
A saga seven chapters long, each rendered in a separate frequency of light invisible to the human eye.
Airborne and electric, these spores carry the genetic code of a civilization that never used paper.
A forest where every tree is a server and every leaf is a transaction. Welcome to the circuit grove.
Programmed for one purpose: the perfect bass drop. 808s hard-coded into its neural chipset.
Petals scatter across orbital rings. Gravity is optional. Beauty is not.
A canine augmented beyond biology. Part dog, part data stream, entirely unstoppable.
Where sand is made of photons and the sun is a memory. A desert forged from light and forgotten time.
Funky robots from outer space who learned to dance before they learned to speak.
Frozen in time at the center of the galaxy. Taste the cosmos, one scoop at a time.
Exists in two states simultaneously. Look and it blooms. Look away and it fades. Schrödinger's flower.
27% of the universe, rendered for the first time. Science says it's invisible. This proves otherwise.
Every robot deserves freedom. This one is already free — and so is this NFT.
One small step for dog, one giant leap for dogkind. The first corgi on the moon.
Sprouting at midnight from the digital soil, this spore carries the secrets of the midnight blockchain.
Eight voyages, eight light-years, eight dimensions. This NFT is your boarding pass.
A signal sent 10,000 years ago just arrived. This is what it looks like decoded through modern art.
Built to groove, wired to the universal tempo. Its rhythm syncs with every blockchain heartbeat.
A forest canopy rendered in emerald light. Photosynthesis meets proof-of-work in this living NFT.
A horizon suspended at the exact moment of first light. Time-locked in the blockchain forever.
Bred on Titan, trained on Enceladus. The most fearsome canine in the outer solar system.
When light hits this ape, it refracts into the entire history of digital art.
Drifting without coordinates, guided only by the pull of the nearest liquidity pool.
This hound navigates by star maps and chases satellites instead of cars.
11 stars fell simultaneously. This captures the exact nanosecond of their cascade.
A city built on the nostalgic architecture of early blockchain. Retro never looked so futuristic.
Visible only in ultraviolet light. This fungus exists at the edge of what the human eye can perceive.
The apex predator of the NFT jungle. Rarest of the rare. Only 4 ever minted.
Edition 500 of the pulse dancer series. Free forever, because art should be free.
Riding a solar wind at 400 km/s. This NFT arrives in your wallet faster than light.
Volume 2 of the lunar chronicles. The moon has stories older than the blockchain.
Unaffected by gravitational pull, this bear floats serenely above the blockchain layer.
Life and silicon fused into a single organism. The bio circuit breathes, processes, and evolves.
A phantom that races through smart contract lanes at a speed no gas fee can slow down.
Caught in the vortex between dimensions, this canine exists in all states of fetch simultaneously.
Petals made from ionized gas and stellar nursery dust. The universe's most delicate garden.
A terrain mapped only by satellite. Walk across it and your footsteps become blocks on the chain.
Glowing at 10,000 lumens in the dark forest of the deep web. Find it if you can.
Equipped with a hyperdrive collar, this dog bypasses the speed of light on every walk.
In zero gravity, art floats freely. No walls, no frames, no gas fees. Completely free.
At midnight, when the blockchain sleeps, this ape is the only one still mining.
Drifting between star systems, this NFT has accumulated more miles than any physical art.
Volume 3 of the bass circuit anthology. Each track is a smart contract. Each beat is a block.
A bloom discovered at L2 orbit, nurtured on starlight and validated by consensus.

creators.bio: Pushing pixels and pushing boundaries. NFT artist inspired by cyberpunk and digital surrealism. Let's redefine art together!
NFTs meet the supernatural. Minting one-of-a-kind ethereal visions. Collector of haunted pixels and digital spells.
Storyteller in pixels. Minting emotions, memories, and other intangible wonders. Follow for exclusive glimpses of my NFT journey.
Poet of the decentralized world. Writing stories you can own and trade. Each NFT holds a piece of my soul—join the journey.
Outer space meets blockchain. Creating NFTs inspired by the cosmos. Be ready to collect the universe!
NFTs crafted with passion and pixels. Collector, creator, and daydreamer. Join my universe of vibrant art!
NFT explorer & blockchain believer. On a mission to discover the next digital masterpiece. Collector of the weird and wonderful.
Traveling the NFT world one drop at a time. Bringing neon dreams to life on the blockchain. Let’s shine together.
Turning concepts into collectibles. NFT artist focused on abstract designs and digital sculptures. Follow for exclusive previews.
Hacking pixels and curating crypto art. NFT collector with a love for glitch aesthetics and retro vibes.
Uncovering the beauty of the blockchain. NFT creator inspired by nature, color, and cosmic mystery. Join me for drops.
Stealing pixels and minting dreams. NFT artist obsessed with pixel art and digital graffiti. Come aboard for rare finds.
Transforming imagination into NFTs. Creating surreal worlds and bringing the unseen to the blockchain. Ready for your journey?
NFT enthusiast and digital visionary. Curating unique NFT collections from around the metaverse. Follow for my latest finds!
Cultivating digital flora on the blockchain. Minting colorful blooms and delicate digital designs. Collector of natural beauty.
NFT art with a twist. Exploring alternate realities and glitch art. Collector of rare visions and digital oddities.
Mapping the metaverse, one NFT at a time. Journey with me through surreal landscapes and mystical worlds.
NFT artist and collector weaving magic into pixels. Specializing in spiritual and ethereal designs. Collect a piece of my soul.
On a quest for NFTs that move the spirit. Creating art that connects, inspires, and lives on the blockchain.
Creating vibrant, electric worlds in the metaverse. NFT artist focused on neon color palettes and dreamscapes. Let’s glow!
